ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of low-intensity (central dark pigmentation) to high-intensity (white distal lobes) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity region forming a broad V-shape from the peduncle to the notch. Distal lobes are high-intensity with significant low-intensity mottling concentrated along the trailing edges. A distinct, isolated low-intensity pixel cluster is located on the right distal lobe approximately 15% inward from the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Standard V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 95 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration pattern; the left lobe trailing edge features minor, frequent peaks, while the right lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular peaks and deep valleys including approximately 4 major jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the leading edges of both lobes, transitioning to a sharply tapering distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular spots scattered across the high-intensity right lobe surface; several high-intensity punctate marks detected within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of short, dark linear marks oriented roughly 45 degrees relative to the trailing edge on the white background of the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss or trauma on the trailing edge of the right lobe resulting in a jagged, saw-tooth profile. Notable deep indentation on the far-right distal tip boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific horizontal dark bar-like pigmentation mark on the interior white field of the right lobe, proximal to the most jagged section of the trailing edge.
